deals.comment: Youngho Park, Jaekwan Nam, Woongkyu Choi and others acquired 5.46% stake in Supernova11 Co., Ltd. from Daejin Kim for KRW 7.3 million on September 6, 2017. Daejin Kim transferred 0.07 million shares at KRW 100 per share. Under the terms of the transaction, Youngho Park, Jaekwan Nam, Woongkyu Choi and others acquired 1.64%, 1.64%, 0.9%, and 1.28% respectively.

Kakao Games Corporation agreed to acquire remaining 28.59% stake in Supernova11 Co., Ltd. for KRW 5.5 billion on October 31, 2017. The exchange ratio for the transaction is 0.0019202 and Kakao Games will issue 746 shares at an issue price of KRW 7.36 million per share as consideration. Kakao Games Corporation held 71.4% stake and upon closing it will hold 100% stake in Supernova11 Co., Ltd.

As of December 31, 2016, Supernova11 reported total assets of KRW 2.66 billion and net liabilities of KRW 600 million. The general meeting of shareholders will be held on December 1, 2017. The transaction was resolved by the Board of Directors of Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720). The transaction is expected to close on December 22, 2017.

Friendsgames Co., Ltd. agreed to acquire 51.22% stake in NGLE Corporation from Kakao Games Corporation for approximately KRW 300 million on March 29, 2018. A contract was signed on March 30, 2018. Under the terms of the acquisition, 0.21 million shares will be acquired at KRW 1450 per share. The Board of Directors passed a resolution on the transaction on March 29, 2018.

Friendsgames Co., Ltd. acquired 34.44% stake in Sonnori Corp. from Kakao Games Corporation for KRW 5.9 billion on March 30, 2018. Under the terms of the transaction, Friendsgames Co., Ltd. acquired 0.14 million common shares and 0.11 million preferred shares at KRW 23,522 per share.

Wonsool Lee and Myungjin Jeon acquired 12.69% stake in Sonnori Corp. for approximately KRW 120 million on July 25, 2018. A total of 0.051 million shares will be acquired as part of the deal for KRW 2400 per share.

Friendsgames Co., Ltd. acquired additional 18.18% stake in Sonnori Corp. for KRW 4 billion on October 24, 2018. A total of 0.11 million shares will be acquired as part of the deal for KRW 35,001 per share. Friendsgames will hold 58.28% stake in Sonnori after this deal.
